title: Collective Exclusion Certificates for Complete Regularization Paths under Interval-Valued Segment Costs
description: Software and reproducibility artifacts accompanying the manuscript 'Collective Exclusion Certificates for Complete Regularization Paths under Interval-Valued Segment Costs'. The release includes exact continuous witness-interval certification, exact closed-support filtering, archive-independent witness generation, the R333/R343/R372 fitted-cost acquisition pipeline, frozen interval-cost boxes, analytical constructions, exhaustive validation, and paired benchmark outputs. Source code and scripts are licensed under MIT. Authors' derived numerical data, frozen cost boxes, processed windows, experiment tables, and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0; see DATA_LICENSE.md. The original UCI raw archives and the upstream SKAB dataset are not redistributed.
